mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 77 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, though the air quality index is 51, which is elevated. We are in the first quarter moon phase, and the space station will be visible for one minute starting at 3:23 AM, rising over Belleville and moving toward Fitchburg while staying low on the horizon. Tonight, the temperature will dip to a low of 62 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician until September 20. Additionally, new sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently approved to ensure our self-supporting systems continue to operate and avoid infrastructure failures.

There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Hop Haus Trivia, and Concerts in the Park all happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
On Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for a first offence of O W I after being found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
